issues.description: The template's Bitmap24 class header declares save(const std::string&) to return int, but the template implementation defines Bitmap24::save(...) with return type void. The solution repository (intended final state) declares save(...) as void in the header. This mismatch (header vs. implementation in the template) is a structural inconsistency that will cause compilation errors or confusing diagnostics for students (declaration/definition mismatch) and contradicts the solution's API.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the template header's signature match the implementation and the solution: change the declaration in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp from 'int save(const std::string &i_filename);' to 'void save(const std::string &i_filename);'. Then rebuild to verify the header and implementation are consistent.
